description: TBK - Offre théorique et temps réel du réseau de transports du Pays de Quimperlé is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by TBK - Réseau de transports publics de Quimperlé. Transport data in GTFS and GTFS-RT format. Coverage: TBK - Réseau de transports publics de Quimperlé. The portal shows the English title as "TBK - Theoretical and real-time offer of the transport network of the Pays de Quimperlé" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is TBK - Réseau de transports publics de Quimperlé. The listing shows 3 download or service links in GTFS-RT, GTFS. The listing shows 2026-06-05 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
